summary: OptiScreen pivot (watchlist, alerts, learn, Greeks + payoff + scenario matrix) tested end-to-end against public preview URL. 21/21 pytest cases pass in parallel. Watchlist: add is idempotent and normalizes lowercase ticker to uppercase; GET returns {items:[{ticker,name,sector,added_at,quote:{price>0}}], fetched_at}; DELETE removes correctly; all 3 verbs 401 without auth; no _id/user_id leaks at the item level. Alerts: POST /alerts/add returns {alert_id, ticker, kind, threshold, active:true, created_at} with NO user_id and NO _id leaked; invalid kind -> 400; GET /alerts lists all for user; DELETE removes; earnings kind without threshold accepted. Learn: /api/learn/cards is public (no 401) and returns 8 cards (>= 6) each with id/category/title/summary. Options math: /screener/ticker-options AAPL/month returns strategy, legs each enriched with theo_price+delta+gamma+theta+vega, premium_net (signed by credit/debit), breakevens (list), max_profit (number), max_loss (number OR null for Short Strangle - handled), aggregate greeks dict with delta between -2 and 2 (confirmed within range even for Iron Condor near-zero), iv_assumed, scenario_matrix (list of {days_elapsed, pnl:dict}), assumptions object, data_source with quote+fetched_at. /screener/best-options week/limit=3 returns results each with max_profit/max_loss/breakevens/greeks/scenario_matrix. /screener/quote/AAPL returns {price>0, fetched_at, source:'Finnhub'} and 401 without auth. Regression: /auth/login, /user/questionnaire, /screener/stock-analysis(swing) all still return 200 with expected shapes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:597-636 watchlist — upsert-based add is correctly idempotent; .upper() normalization applied; GET fetches live quotes in parallel via asyncio.gather. Mongo projection {_id:0, user_id:0} properly excludes leaks. Good.
server.py:640-668 alerts — alert_id generated with uuid; before returning, both _id and user_id are explicitly popped from the inserted alert, and GET uses projection {_id:0, user_id:0}. Clean. Good.

server.py:94-100 AlertAddReq — threshold is Optional; code does NOT validate that price_above/price_below have a numeric threshold. A nonsense alert like {kind:'price_above', threshold:null} is accepted silently. Low priority but worth adding a guard.

server.py:165-231 build_option_strategy — correctly branches credit vs debit for premium_net sign and calls enrich_legs_with_greeks + analyze_strategy_payoff + scenario_matrix. Aggregate greeks sum across legs is sensible.

server.py:678-763 LEARN_CARDS is a hard-coded module-level list. /learn/cards is intentionally public (no auth) per agent note — confirmed. Fine for MVP, but future i18n/content updates will require redeploy.
server.py:892-906 startup — db.watchlist and db.alerts unique indices created on startup; good for idempotency guarantee.

server.py:586-593 live_quote — returns 404 if Finnhub returns None, otherwise {price, change, ..., fetched_at, source:'Finnhub'}. Source field hardcoded to 'Finnhub' even if cache was populated from Polygon fallback - minor transparency issue.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 pivot tests pass in parallel on public preview URL)

seed_data_creation: Reused existing trader@optiscreen.app seed account. Tests create/delete transient watchlist entries (AAPL) and alerts (TSLA/NVDA/MSFT/AAPL) that may remain in db.alerts for the seed user (tests only clean up alerts they explicitly tracked). No new user accounts persisted beyond uuid-prefixed TEST_ users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pivot suite at /app/backend/tests/test_pivot_features.py (21 tests). Covers watchlist CRUD + idempotent/case-normalize add, alerts CRUD + invalid kind + no user_id leak, public /learn/cards (>=6 cards), /screener/ticker-options full enrichment (Greeks per leg + aggregate, breakevens, max_profit, max_loss nullable, scenario_matrix, data_source), /screener/best-options enriched shape, /screener/quote source=Finnhub, auth guards (401), and regression on /auth/login + /user/questionnaire + /screener/stock-analysis. IMPORTANT when writing new leak checks: alert_id field name contains substring '_id' - do NOT use substring-level checks against serialized JSON; check field names on each item dict instead. max_loss can legitimately be null (Short Strangle undefined) - treat None as valid. Aggregate greeks for Iron Condor are near-zero by design; -2<=delta<=2 is the realistic bound.
rca_of_issue: No backend bugs found in this iteration. One test-script-level false positive observed on first run (TestAlerts.test_list_and_delete): a substring-level assertion `'_id' not in json.dumps(body)` incorrectly flagged the legitimate 'alert_id' field. Fixed in-place by switching to per-field assertions. All real response payloads are confirmed free of _id and user_id leaks.
